q1_passport_validity.question: How much passport validity is required before applying for a visa?
q1_passport_validity.answer: Your passport must have at least 6 months of validity remaining from the intended date of arrival in the destination country, and at least two blank visa pages.

q2_photo_specs.question: What are the exact specifications for the passport photograph?
q2_photo_specs.answer: Photos must be recent (taken within the last 6 months), square format (2x2 inches / 51x51 mm), full frontal face on a plain white or light-off-white background with both ears visible and no shadows, spectacles, or headgear (except religious).

q3_file_formats.question: What file formats and file sizes are supported for document uploads?
q3_file_formats.answer: You can upload JPG, JPEG, PNG, or PDF files. Each file may be up to 5 MB. The app automatically optimizes and compresses your files to under 2 MB so you can upload smoothly even on 3G connections.

q4_processing_time.question: How long does it take for a visa application to be processed?
q4_processing_time.answer: Standard electronic visa (e-Visa) processing normally takes 3 to 5 working days. Emergency or expedited visas may be processed within 24 to 48 hours depending on destination consular rules.

q5_payment_methods.question: What payment methods are accepted on VisaReThink?
q5_payment_methods.answer: We accept all major payment modes including UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, CRED), Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, MasterCard, RuPay, American Express), and Net Banking across 50+ Indian banks.

q6_offline_saving.question: Can I fill out the application while offline without internet?
q6_offline_saving.answer: Yes! All your entered answers and uploaded documents are stored securely in your browser's local storage. When you reconnect to the internet, your draft syncs automatically and you can submit.

q7_edit_after_submit.question: Can I edit my application after making the payment?
q7_edit_after_submit.answer: Once submitted and paid, changes cannot be made directly online. If there is a critical correction needed, contact our 24x7 helpline immediately with your Application Reference Number (ARN).

q8_child_application.question: Do infants and minor children need separate visa applications?
q8_child_application.answer: Yes. Every individual traveler, regardless of age (including newborn infants and minors), must possess their own valid passport and have a separate completed visa application.

q9_visa_on_arrival.question: Is Visa on Arrival (VoA) available for all nationalities?
q9_visa_on_arrival.answer: Visa on Arrival privileges depend strictly on bilateral agreements between countries. Most international travelers are strongly advised to obtain an e-Visa before boarding their flight to avoid boarding denial.

q10_reference_contact.question: What should I enter for reference contacts in the destination country?
q10_reference_contact.answer: If visiting friends/family, provide their name, phone number, and physical address. For tourism, you may provide your booked hotel name, manager contact, and hotel address.

q11_port_of_entry.question: Can I arrive at a different airport or seaport than indicated in my application?
q11_port_of_entry.answer: Yes, for most e-Visas, you may enter through any authorized International Immigration Check Post (ICP) airport or seaport within the destination country unless explicitly restricted.

q12_multiple_entry.question: What is the difference between single-entry and multiple-entry visas?
q12_multiple_entry.answer: A single-entry visa becomes invalid once you exit the country. A multiple-entry visa allows you to enter and exit the country multiple times during the overall validity period of the visa.

q13_name_mismatch.question: What if my name has only one word (no surname/family name)?
q13_name_mismatch.answer: If your passport has only a single name, enter that name under 'Given Name' and repeat it or leave Surname empty based on field instructions. Never invent or guess fictitious names.

q14_emergency_visa.question: How do I apply for an urgent or emergency visa for medical/bereavement reasons?
q14_emergency_visa.answer: Select the 'Medical Emergency' or 'Urgent' visa track on Stage 1. Attach supporting death certificates or hospital admission letters to expedite consular queue prioritization.

q15_refund_policy.question: Are visa application fees refundable if my application is rejected?
q15_refund_policy.answer: Consular and government visa processing fees are non-refundable once processing commences, regardless of the visa decision outcome, as per international diplomatic regulations.

q16_tracking_status.question: How can I track the live status of my submitted application?
q16_tracking_status.answer: You can track your application at any time using the 'Track Application' tab by entering your Application Reference Number (ARN) and Passport Number or Date of Birth.

q17_clear_data.question: How do I erase my personal data if I am using a public cyber café computer?
q17_clear_data.answer: Click the 'Clear saved draft' or 'Reset Public Computer' button in the header or footer. This will immediately wipe all cached answers, personal details, and documents from the local browser.

q18_security_privacy.question: How does VisaReThink secure my sensitive passport and financial data?
q18_security_privacy.answer: VisaReThink uses end-to-end client-side sandboxing, 256-bit TLS encryption in transit, zero third-party telemetry, and zero unconsented data retention.

givenNameVsSurname.title: Given Name vs. Surname
givenNameVsSurname.explanation: Given Name refers to your first name and middle name(s). Surname is your last name or family name. Look at the two zones on your passport bio-page.
givenNameVsSurname.example: If your passport reads: Surname: 'SHARMA', Given Names: 'AARAV KUMAR', enter 'AARAV KUMAR' as Given Name and 'SHARMA' as Surname.

dateOfIssueVsExpiry.title: Date of Issue vs. Date of Expiry
dateOfIssueVsExpiry.explanation: Date of Issue is the day your passport was granted by the passport office. Date of Expiry is the day your passport ceases to be valid for international travel.
dateOfIssueVsExpiry.example: Date of Issue is in the past; Date of Expiry is in the future (must be at least 6 months after your travel date).

placeOfIssue.title: Place of Issue
placeOfIssue.explanation: The city, authority, or passport seva kendra that issued your passport document, printed on the first page.

cvv.title: CVV / Card Security Code
cvv.explanation: A 3-digit number printed on the signature strip on the back of your Visa/MasterCard/RuPay card (or 4-digit on the front of Amex cards).
cvv.example: Used to verify that you physically possess the payment card.

vpa.title: UPI ID / VPA (Virtual Payment Address)
vpa.explanation: Your unique virtual identifier for Unified Payments Interface (UPI) instant payments.

mrz.title: MRZ (Machine Readable Zone)
mrz.explanation: The two lines of letters, numbers, and chevron symbols (<<<) printed at the very bottom of your passport photo page.
mrz.example: Contains encoded name, passport number, nationality, birth date, and check digits for border scanner systems.
